publicationNote: Actual runtime-release receipts and all 12 formal packages match the final approved registries and this round five-map group / 390x844 CSS free-showcase browser evidence. This does not claim physical-phone FPS or memory profiling.

scope.method: Reuse prior original neural source; bounded CPU material transfer and specific inspected geometry/UV corrections. No full-map regeneration.
scope.preserved: All 17 original neural sources and prior approved candidates remain hash-verified. Unselected near/far candidate SHA values remain unchanged; existing map layouts and animation mechanics were not redesigned.
scope.exceptions: Kyoto uses a new reduction and bounded source repairs; four classic assets have explicitly recorded local UV/normal/eave repairs; harbor wheel has an isolated local color map. Alpine wheel only detaches the bad normal-map binding. See per-asset limitations; source geometry irregularities are not all removed.
